Definition: middle voice from G4862 and G3307; to share jointly, i.e. participate in:--be partaker with.
BiblicalUsage: Paul asks whether those who minister about holy things live of the things of the temple, and those who wait at the altar are partakers with the altar. The point is plain: those who serve God should be supported by the work they serve, because sharing in the service means sharing in its provision.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that God provides for those who give their lives to His service, and I hold that supporting them is part of worship, not an afterthought.
